newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Applied Materials to buy Opal, Orbot.
newsitem.headline: Applied Materials to buy Opal, Orbot.

text.p: Applied Materials said it had entered into a definitive agreement to acquire two Israeli companies -- Opal Inc and Orbot Instruments Ltd -- for a total of approximately $285 million.
Applied Materials said it would buy Opal, a leading supplier of semiconductor test equipment, for about $175 million and Orbot, a supplier of wafer inspection systems, for about $110 million in cash.
Israel's Clal Electronics Industries, a subsidiary of Clal Industries, announced it would receive $50 million for the sale of its stake in Opal.
Dennis Hunter, spokesman for Applied Materials Inc, said the companies had entered into a definitive agreement which was expected to be finalised in about a month.
Applied Materials is a leading maker of equipment used to produce computer chips.
